slice.paper: The Little Scientist: LLM Agent-Driven Discovery via the Scientific Method, arXiv:2608.16951v1
observations: The inspected UTF-8 stats artifact contains only aggregate benchmark fields: population counts, per-method aggregate AUROC and selected timing values, Wilcoxon p-values, and aggregate win/loss/tie counts.

For the shuffled population, wins+losses+ties equals n_tf exactly: 85+43+4=132. For the genomic population, wins+losses covers 51 of n_tf=53 and the artifact has no tie, omission, failed-case, or denominator-exception field explaining the remaining two cases.

The artifact contains no per-transcription-factor scores, no per-case predictions/labels, no ordered reducer inputs, and no reducer implementation or verifier transcript. Therefore its AUROC means, Wilcoxon p-values, and win/loss aggregates cannot be independently recomputed from this artifact alone; they can only be copied or internally consistency-checked where sufficient aggregate counts are present.

The artifact contains no explicit realized run identifier or run digest, no declared-input digest, no benchmark/evaluation-contract digest, no independent verifier identity/result/provenance, and no field binding these aggregate statistics to a specific realized execution beyond the Git blob identity of the artifact itself.
slice.inference: benchmark_data/stats.json closes the scoreboard's immediate data-source pointer at the level of committed aggregate values, but it does not close the stronger static replay requirement: it is an aggregate result cache rather than reducer-ready row evidence. It therefore cannot independently regenerate the reported AUROC, Wilcoxon, and comparison-count outcomes without some additional per-case evidence or executed benchmark path.
slice.scope_guard: This finding applies only to benchmark_data/stats.json blob 4d69a592cd12a40dca4b1bbfb153cc0f69759a16 at the pinned tree. No claim is made about other benchmark_data files, notebooks, external archives, uncommitted logs, or later revisions; those may still contain row-level evidence or execution binding.
